text:
Anna (Product): FYI ACME asked if we can go live with a private-hosted pilot in 4 weeks. Main asks: 99.9 SLA, p95 <=150ms for typical prompts (~1k tokens), VPC + KMS, and canary rollout. Can runtime/infra/security confirm blockers?
Marcus (Runtime): 4 weeks is tight but maybe doable if we scope. Need clarity on model choice (quantized vs fp16) and expected QPS. Also prefix KV cache requirements.
Anna (Product): QPS ~60 steady, bursts to 150 for short windows. They want ability to pin to a quantized variant if perf OK.
Priya (Infra): VPC + KMS is fine, but onprem HSM integration will add ~2w. For cloud VPC with KMS we can do within 1w if no custom routing. Need subnet/security group info from their infra.
Sarah (Security): Compliance checklist: data residency, audit logs, KMS key ownership, and threat model signoff. Audit logs retention default is 90d; customer needs 1y — that needs infra + console retention change.
Luis (SRE): 150ms p95 for 1k tokens is aggressive. Need to know tokenization distribution (prompt vs generation). If most requests are short prefixes we can hit it with prewarming; long-generation tails blow up latency.
Tom (Design): On the UX side we need to surface graceful degradation if fallback occurs (e.g., hosted model). Suggest short banner + telemetry event.
Marcus (Runtime): Actionable list from my side: (1) pick model variant; (2) baseline perf with our 8xA100 pool; (3) prepare fallback policy to smaller model. I can run perf tests this week if we get sample prompts.
Anna (Product): I have sanitized prompt set from ACME. Dropping in #file-share. Can we plan perf run by EOD Fri?
Marcus (Runtime): Yep, will run batch sims and KV cache experiments. If we need <150ms p95 we'll likely require prefix caching + 8-token KV prefetch.
Priya (Infra): For the private deployment we'll need a CIDR, egress controls, and preferred region. Also: SLA negotiation — Dedicated capacity reserved instances needed for 99.9. How long is pilot (1 month)?
Anna (Product): Pilot = 3 months. Sales expects to convert if stability is good. They will commit to a 6-month dedicated contract if SLA met.
Sarah (Security): KMS ownership: customer-managed key (CMK) ok. We'll need AAD/OAuth mapping and an HSM gap doc if they later demand HSM. I'll start the security checklist and identify any gating items.
Luis (SRE): Can we schedule a canary rollout window? I propose: weekday 02:00-05:00 UTC low traffic, 10% traffic for 1h, 30% for 2h, then 100% if no errors. If autoscaler triggers >3x baseline or error rate >1% rollback.
Marcus (Runtime): That rollout plan is OK. Quick snippet for the rollout policy to share with infra/security:
```
canary:
  windows:
    - start: "02:00"
      duration: "180m"
  stages:
    - traffic: 0.10
      duration: "60m"
    - traffic: 0.30
      duration: "120m"
    - traffic: 1.00
  healthchecks:
    p95_latency_ms: 150
    error_rate_pct: 1.0
    autoscaler_limit: 3.0
```
Anna (Product): Nice. Priya, can infra guarantee route fallback to hosted redwood-api if private pool errors during canary?
Priya (Infra): Yes, we can add a routing policy to fall back to hosted model with header-based tagging. Need to confirm cost + data handling (hosted path must abide by customer data rules).
Sarah (Security): Hosted fallback only if customer signs waiver for transient token leakage risk. Otherwise we need on-prem fallback. I'll draft options.
Marcus (Runtime): One more runtime note: to meet latency we might need quantize-aware kernels + static KV allocation. That means a short runtime deploy (2d) to enable optimized kernels for selected model.
Anna (Product): OK — summary and owners: Anna -> ACME comms; Marcus -> perf + runtime deploy; Priya -> VPC/KMS + routing; Sarah -> security checklist + waiver; Luis -> canary ops; Tom -> UX fallback banner. Can everyone ack and add risks?
Marcus (Runtime): Ack. Risk: model regressions after quantization. Need eval harness.
Priya (Infra): Ack. Risk: customer network config delays. Ask: CIAM creds from ACME by Wed.
Sarah (Security): Ack. Risk: audit retention policy change needs console/infra work.
Luis (SRE): Ack. Risk: autoscaler thrash during burst. We'll add a warmup prewarm window.
Tom (Design): Ack. I'll mock banner and telemetry strings by Tue.
Anna (Product): Great — I'll schedule a 30m triage tomorrow 10:30 PT. If anyone can't make, ping me. :thumbsup:

Anna (Product): Thanks all, I'll follow up with prompt set link and contract constraints.
